content.title: San Antonio Spurs vs Denver Nuggets Live Stream: How To Watch NBA
content.text: Nikola Jokic and the Denver Nuggets host Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs in a clash of MVP candidates. The game of the week in the NBA features two of the best teams in the league. The San Antonio Spurs (59-18) and Denver Nuggets (49-28) have combined to win 18 straight games heading into the second-to-last matchup between the teams. San Antonio has won 11 straight and 27 of the last 29 overall to secure the second seed in the Western Conference. Denver has won seven straight and 10 of the last 12 games overall. The teams split the first two games of the season, with San Antonio winning the first (139-136) back in November and Denver winning the second (136-131) in an exciting fourth-quarter comeback. Victor Wembanyama missed the second game, leading to a monster Nikola Jokic triple-double. Jokic finished with 31 points, 20 rebounds, and 12 assists on 11-11 shooting from the free-throw line. He has 52 points, 29 rebounds, and 22 assists in two games against San Antonio this season. This is actually the first meeting of the season between the two MVP candidates. Wembanayma has made a case for MVP over the last 27 games. Wembanyama is averaging 25.6 points, 11.9 rebounds, 3.6 blocks, 3.4 assists, and 1.3 steals per game over his last 27 games (26-1) with 19 double-doubles.
